module Fluent
  module Config
    module YamlParser
      class Loader
        INCLUDE_TAG = 'tag:include'.freeze
        FLUENT_JSON_TAG = 'tag:fluent/json'.freeze
        FLUENT_STR_TAG = 'tag:fluent/s'.freeze
        SHOVEL = '<<'.freeze

        def initialize(context = Kernel.binding)
          @context = context
          @current_path = nil
        end

        # @param [String] path
        # @return [Hash]
        def load(path)
          class_loader = Psych::ClassLoader.new
          scanner = Psych::ScalarScanner.new(class_loader)

          visitor = Visitor.new(scanner, class_loader)

          visitor._register_domain(INCLUDE_TAG) do |_, val|
            load(path.parent.join(val))
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_JSON_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::JsonValue.new(val)
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_STR_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::StringValue.new(val, @context)
          end

          path.open do |f|
            visitor.accept(Psych.parse(f))
          end
        end

        class Visitor < Psych::Visitors::ToRuby
          def initialize(scanner, class_loader)
            super(scanner, class_loader)
          end

          def _register_domain(name, &block)
            @domain_types.merge!({ name => [name, block] })
          end

          def revive_hash(hash, o)
            super(hash, o).tap do |r|
              if r[SHOVEL].is_a?(Hash)
                h2 = {}
                r.each do |k, v|
                  if k == SHOVEL
                    h2.merge!(v)
                  else
                    h2[k] = v
                  end
                end
                r.replace(h2)
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def prepare_eval_context
          ensure_use_nil_helper
          ensure_use_default_helper
          ensure_hostname_helper
          ensure_worker_id_helper
          eval_context_binding
        end

        def ensure_use_nil_helper
          unless @context.respond_to?(:use_nil)
            @context.define_singleton_method(:use_nil) do
              raise Fluent::SetNil
            end
          end
          @context
        end

        def ensure_use_default_helper
          unless @context.respond_to?(:use_default)
            @context.define_singleton_method(:use_default) do
              raise Fluent::SetDefault
            end
          end
          @context
        end

        def ensure_hostname_helper
          unless @context.respond_to?(:hostname)
            @context.define_singleton_method(:hostname) do
              Socket.gethostname
            end
          end
          @context
        end

        def ensure_worker_id_helper
          unless @context.respond_to?(:worker_id)
            @context.define_singleton_method(:worker_id) do
              ENV['SERVERENGINE_WORKER_ID'] || ''
            end
          end
          @context
        end

        def capture_current_path(path)
          previous = @current_path
          @current_path = path
          @context
          previous
        end

        def current_include_base
          if @current_path.nil?
            nil
          elsif @current_path.respond_to?(:parent)
            @current_path.parent
          else
            @current_path
          end
        end

        def with_current_path(path)
          previous = capture_current_path(path)
          begin
            current_include_base
            yield
          ensure
            @current_path = previous
            @context
          end
        end

        def eval_context_binding
          @context
        end

        def materialize(config, base_indent = 2)
          @config = config
          @base_indent = base_indent
          build_root_from_config
        end

        def build_root_from_config
          RootBuilder.new(materialize_system_if_present, materialize_config_if_present)
        end

        def build_system_section(config)
          build_generic_section('system', config, indent: 0 * @base_indent)
        end

        def build_config_body(config, indent: 0, root: false)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          sb = SectionBodyBuilder.new(indent, root: root)
          config.each do |entry|
            append_named_top_level(sb, entry, indent)
          end
          sb
        end

        def append_named_top_level(sb, entry, indent)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          if entry.respond_to?(:delete)
            top_level_section_keys.each do |key|
              body = delete_config_key(entry, key)
              if body
                sb.add_section(dispatch_included_section(key, body, indent))
              end
            end
            build_included_sections(entry, sb, indent: indent)
          else
            build_included_sections(entry, sb, indent: indent)
          end
          sb
        end

        def build_label_section(config, indent: 0)
          config = copy_section_config(config)
          name = delete_config_key(config, '$name')
          nested = delete_config_key(config, 'config')
          SectionBuilder.new('label', build_config_body(nested, indent: indent + @base_indent), indent, name)
        end

        def build_worker_section(config, indent: 0)
          config = copy_section_config(config)
          num = delete_config_key(config, '$arg')
          nested = delete_config_key(config, 'config')
          SectionBuilder.new('worker', build_config_body(nested, indent: indent + @base_indent), indent, num)
        end

        def build_source_section(config, indent: 0)
          ensure_indent_step_configured
          build_generic_section('source', config, indent: indent)
        end

        def build_filter_section(config, indent: 0)
          config = copy_section_config(config)
          tag = delete_config_key(config, '$tag')
          build_generic_section('filter', config, indent: indent, arg: argument_from_tag(tag))

          config = copy_section_config(config)
          tag = delete_config_key(config, '$tag')
          build_generic_section('match', config, indent: indent, arg: argument_from_tag(tag))

      k8 wildcard_include_3
      <elem4 name>
        include normal_parameter
      </elem4>
    ]

  end

    assert_equal 'absolute_path_include', c['k4']

      'k2',

      'k4',

      'k7',

      def process_include(attrs, elems, uri, allow_include = true)
        u = URI.parse(uri)
        if u.scheme == 'file' || u.path == uri  # file path
          path = u.path
          if path[0] != ?/
            pattern = File.expand_path("#{@basepath}/#{path}")
          else
            pattern = path
          end

          Dir.glob(pattern).sort.each { |entry|
            basepath = File.dirname(entry)
            fname = File.basename(entry)
            File.open(entry) { |f|
              Parser.new(basepath, f.each_line, fname).parse!(allow_include, nil, attrs, elems)
            }
          }

        else
          basepath = '/'
          fname = path
          require 'open-uri'
          URI.open(uri) {|f|
            Parser.new(basepath, f.each_line, fname).parse!(allow_include, nil, attrs, elems)
          }
        end

      rescue SystemCallError => e
        raise ConfigParseError, "include error at #{@fname} line #{@i}: #{e.to_s}"
      end
